Steady-state thermal simulation only; transient thermal behavior during workload transitions not modeled
Coarse granularity of yield model (Negative Binomial) used for cost function; actual defect clustering and spatial correlation not captured

studio_assumptions: SCBO trust-region adjustment threshold th=16 for convergence balance (Section V.E)
Process node 14nm scaled from 28nm synthesized results using DeepScaleTool
Operating frequency fixed at 1.8GHz (peak frequency from Simba reference)
Ambient temperature 45°C with convection resistance 0.4K/W for restricted cooling conditions (HotSpot 6.0 default)
D2D link energy modeled as clock-forwarding type (e.g., GRS, UCIe) with 1.17pJ/bit and 81Kµm² per 25Gb/s bandwidth
Auxiliary modules (control unit, NoC router, DMA) account for ~30% of die area following Chiplet-Gym assumptions
Negative Binomial yield model with defect density d=0.08 and clustering parameter α=10 (Chiplet-actuary parameters)
TIM, heat spreader, and heat sink thermal properties adopted from TESA reference work
Fine-grained task orchestration with utilization-directed partitioning and DP-based scheduling for µtask allocation
LIFO write-back policy for uniform buffer management
Double-buffering on all on-chip buffers except uniform buffer to overlap data access and computation
Weight-stationary systolic array with zero-padding for non-aligned dimensions
4-channel DRAM configuration with 4GB total capacity and 128GB/s peak bandwidth
NoC and DRAM energy consumption at 0.6pJ/bit and 8pJ/bit respectively
